description: Layer scores for a US location: school quality, natural hazards, groundwater contamination, Superfund proximity, air quality, highway noise, walkability, crime, and climate pleasantness (pleasant days/year). Scores are 0-1 with 1.0 = favorable; null = cannot score that layer here. The scores are model estimates drawn from public datasets, not safety ratings. no_coverage marks a layer that is null because this location lies outside that layer's data, and caveats.<layer> says why. When a layer's number has limits the score alone does not show (a proxy, partial source data), caveats.<layer> states them. Superfund proximity weighs each cleanup site by the nearer of the area EPA maps for it and the one point EPA lists for it; where EPA maps no area, a site that stretches out (a canal, a plume) can be closer than the score reflects. The scores are not a safety assessment, and an absence of adverse signals is not a clean bill of health. Coverage: Superfund/toxic-release proximity national; air quality, groundwater, and natural hazards a San Francisco Bay Area grid (lat 37.0 to 38.6, lon -122.8 to -121.4, which also takes in Sacramento), null elsewhere; highway noise Bay Area; walkability California; schools all 50 states and DC (2023-2025 results); climate CONUS (gridMET 4km, 2015-2024); Alaska, the Florida Keys, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands (Daymet V4, 2011-2020); within 40 km of 3 NOAA weather stations in American Samoa, the Northern Mariana Islands and Guam (2016-2025); null elsewhere; crime police incident feeds inside the city limits of San Francisco; Oakland; Chicago; New York City; Los Angeles; Dallas; Washington, DC; and Kansas City, Missouri only. School scores draw on the Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA), whose terms require naming it as the source: Reardon, S. F., Ho, A. D., Shear, B. R., Fahle, E. M., Kalogrides, D., Saliba, J. (2024). Stanford Education Data Archive (Version 5.0). [https://purl.stanford.edu/cs829jn7849] [https://doi.org/10.25740/cs829jn7849] (also in citations.school_quality). Input is either a street address (geocoded by the US Census geocoder) or lat/lon coordinates.

address.description: US street address incl. city/state (alternative to lat/lon)

lon.description: Longitude (US; negative except Guam, NMI and the western Aleutians)

name: location_scores
title: Score a location's public-record layers
